_comment: Devotional formulae that are legitimately CHANTED in repetition (zikr). Used only by src/srt_pipeline/repetition.py to label a detected repeated run `chant` instead of `suspect_loop`. Adding a unit here NEVER changes what reaches the manifest -- repetition is excluded from training either way, because a fine-tune that sees a 178x repeated sample learns to loop. What this list changes is whether we believe the SRT TEXT: a `chant` run is correctly transcribed, a `suspect_loop` run is probably fabricated by the decoder and is the only signal we have that decode settings need fixing. Matching is on the normalized unit -- NFC, diacritics and punctuation stripped -- so write the bare form: 'اللہ ہو' also matches 'اللہ ہو،'.
_seeded: 2026-08-09 from the batch3 repetition scan (20 episodes). Deliberately conservative: only Allah-formulae confirmed by ear or unambiguous by form. Two observed units were left OFF pending review -- 'اٹھ' (B3004, 7 cues) and 'را ریاض' (B3015, 40 cues). Both may be genuine; until someone listens they classify as suspect_loop, which is the honest state. Check data/processed/<Batch>/repetition_exclusions.json for units to promote here.
